method: JFR stack samples and allocation weights are attribution estimates, not measured whole-frame CPU/GPU percentages. First allocation sample per thread is omitted because its weight can include pre-recording allocation. Thread allocation deltas use periodic cumulative counters. Profiler runs are excluded from acceptance FPS tests.
selectionReason: Use existing texture-readback and animation-allocation hotspots to remove synthesis/layers and throttle animation evaluation; no additional profiling run.
